regionalModel: Metropolitan French reference; regional variants require review

lessons.title: Hear ch /ʃ/ and gn /ɲ/ on a trail
lessons.objective: Recognize French ch and gn as sound spellings in words for a trail, a chalet, and a mountain.
lessons.focus: Compare chemin, chalet, and chaud with montagne, ligne, and signal. Say the sound of each letter group in the word instead of naming its letters.

words.en: The path leads to the chalet.

words.fr: La montagne est derrière le chalet.
words.en: The mountain is behind the chalet.

words.fr: Une ligne rouge marque le chemin.
words.en: A red line marks the path.

words.fr: Il fait chaud près du chalet.
words.en: It is warm near the chalet.

reader.fr: Nous suivons une ligne rouge sur le chemin.
reader.en: We follow a red line on the path.

reader.fr: Un signal indique la direction du chalet.
reader.en: A signal indicates the direction of the chalet.

reader.fr: La montagne est derrière le chalet.
reader.en: The mountain is behind the chalet.

reader.fr: Il fait chaud, alors nous nous arrêtons près du chalet.
reader.en: It is warm, so we stop near the chalet.

speaking.scene: Following a marked trail to a chalet
goals: Describe the red line marking the path.
Ask your companion to confirm the signal.

see.prompt: Sort chemin, chalet, chaud, montagne, ligne, and signal by ch or gn spelling.

recall.prompt: Recall the French word for mountain before revealing it.

hear.prompt: Listen for chemin or chalet in the recorded trail sentence.

type.prompt: Type the French sentence for 'The path leads to the chalet.'

say.prompt: Tell your companion where the mountain is.
say.answerRef: La montagne est derrière le chalet.

write.prompt: Write two French sentences about the marked path and the mountain.

lessons.title: Transfer sounds into a station passage
lessons.objective: Read unfamiliar station words and a short passage using the French vowel, consonant, and spelling patterns from Foundation.
lessons.focus: Read quai, guichet, billet, valise, départ, and sortie as whole words. Link words within each short phrase, then place the strongest beat near the phrase end.

words.fr: Mon billet indique le quai quatre.
Le départ est à neuf heures.
La sortie est derrière le guichet.
words.en: The exit is behind the ticket window.

reader.fr: J'entre dans la gare avec ma valise.
reader.en: I enter the station with my suitcase.

reader.fr: Au guichet, je demande un billet pour le départ de neuf heures.
reader.en: At the ticket window, I ask for a ticket for the nine o'clock departure.

reader.fr: Le billet indique le quai quatre.
Après le voyage, je suis les panneaux vers la sortie.
reader.en: After the trip, I follow the signs toward the exit.

speaking.scene: Finding a train platform before departure
goals: Ask for a ticket for the nine o'clock departure.
speaking.closure: Merci, je vais au quai quatre.

see.prompt: Read the six new station words and identify a sound pattern learned earlier in each.

recall.prompt: Recall the French word for platform before revealing it.

hear.prompt: Listen for guichet or quai in the recorded station question.

type.prompt: Type the French sentence for 'My ticket shows platform four.'
type.answerRef: Mon billet indique le quai quatre.

say.prompt: Ask the station agent where the ticket window is, with a clear phrase ending.

write.prompt: Write a short French station exchange asking for the ticket window, giving a departure time, and naming the platform.
